method: I compared the r13 renders (head 72770eb, which carries the 0c2b6fb w12 post-rating fixes) with omaat_f60, f57, f7 and f11, up_34, and ANA f_17313 and f_17301. Colours are PIL box means on luminance (L) or RGB, compared as ratios within one image. Flute relief is p90/p10 of the column-mean L across a leaf band (v1 x 232-325, y 200-300). Crops are in scratchpad/qa13a/: q04_duvet.png, f57_duvet.png, q04_drape.png, s5_bed.png, v4_right.png, v4_left.png, v1_plinth.png, f60_plinth.png, v1_seam.png and q02R.png. Code is src/09d_suite.js (361 lines). Lighting is noted but not scored.

calibration.earlier_issue: w11a/b MED: with the doors closed, a continuous plinth ran under the meeting leaves
calibration.status: still fixed. In v1 the void is L19 against the field's L83 (0.23x). f60 measured the same way gives 17/73 (0.23x). Plinth/field is 57/83 = 0.69, against f60's 46/73 = 0.63.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a LOW: the duvet fold read as a ruled bright rod and an outlined label, with no tonal step
calibration.status: partly fixed. The rod is gone: line 310 is now a 0.06 roll in the duvet colour. The flap (line 309) is L212 against the duvet's L244 (0.87x), which meets the <=0.92 target. Two problems remain. First, the bare-sheet corner (line 308) is L235 against the duvet's 244 (0.96x), so it does not read as exposed sheet. Second, the duvet slab (line 304) still runs square round the corner. The corner therefore reads as two flat overlays on an intact duvet, not a cut-back fold, and the roll reads as a flat lit strip. See qa13a/q04_duvet.png vs f57_duvet.png.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12b LOW: the duvet fold logic was inverted (the flap lay on the corner)
calibration.status: fixed in logic. Sheet is at the head-aisle corner and the flap is across the diagonal, toward the foot and window (correct in q04, s5 and both v4 units). The reading is weak, for the reason above.

calibration.earlier_issue: w11a/b, w12a/b LOW: the console module has hard triangular wedge ends
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 173 is unchanged, and s4 still shows the doorstop end at x 520-545, y 270-300.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a LOW: grip slots were square holes at mid-height of the plinth
calibration.status: fixed in geometry. Line 264 makes them 0.12 x 0.045 at y 0.115, so they are wide and short and sit high on the plinth (v1_plinth.png vs f60_plinth.png). Not fixed in colour: they are still SEATMAT.black, which renders blue-black RGB (21,23,28). The f60 recess is warm (14,15,10) with a lit lower lip (50,52,37).

calibration.earlier_issue: w11b / w12a / w12b LOW: stipple moire on the leaves at grazing and distant angles
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 249 is unchanged, and q02 x 760-900 still shows the chain pattern (qa13a/q02R.png).

calibration.earlier_issue: w12b LOW: the flute grooves are too light
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 19 fFluteGap is unchanged. In v1, groove/slat is 68/91 = 0.75, against about 0.35 in f60. Relief is 1.34, against f60's 1.20-1.27.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a LOW: the wood flanks were too dark
calibration.status: fixed. Line 27 is now #33291f. Flank/field is 49/83 = 0.59, against f60's 0.62, and the grain is legible in v1 and v2.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12b LOW: the doorway void was cool blue-black
calibration.status: fixed. Line 241 gives RGB (22,18,15), against f60's warm brown-black.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a LOW: the duvet head end is a uniform rounded step
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 304 still uses edge 0.04, r 0.05 and crown 0.012.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12a LOW: a 1 px light vertical tick in the forward plinth face with the doors closed
calibration.status: not fixed. The line-262 nudge to hx + 0.003 did not cure it. v1 x 445, y 408-416 still reads L83 inside the L57 plinth. Its position maps to z about -0.77/-0.78, which is the closed aft leaf's end, zm + 0.50, and the flank start in lines 243-244.

calibration.earlier_issue: w12b LOW: doorway proportion (void 0.61 of the closed pair, against 0.40 in f60)
calibration.status: not addressed. Line 243 still uses 0.50 leaves. This was B's open question, so I am not re-scoring it.

calibration.earlier_issue: out of scope: ottoman tweed beige vs charcoal, sun lozenges on the bed, plaques
calibration.status: unchanged (other owners). q04 still has hard sun lozenges, and the q03/q05 ottoman is warm beige where f_17313 and f11 show grey tweed.

details.detail: Proportions and plan (screen wall, wing, pier with mirror and lamp, table, aisle box, ottoman, console)
details.refs: q03/q05 vs omaat_f11, f_17313; q02 vs f_17301 and omaat_f7

details.detail: Aisle leaves, open (frame, slats, LED, pull, foot strip, plinth, slots)
details.refs: s6/s1 vs up_34 and f7. The slots are now the right shape but the wrong colour, and the grooves are too light.

details.detail: Aisle leaves, closed (meeting leaves, flanks, void, plinth)
details.refs: v1/v2/v5 vs omaat_f60. Void 0.23x vs 0.23x; plinth 0.69x vs 0.63x; flank 0.59x vs 0.62x; the void is warm.
Cap/field is v1 189/83 = 2.28, against f60's 2.55. The hue is the accepted middle (unchanged).
s4/q04/v2 vs omaat_f57 and f7. The wedge ends are unchanged.

details.detail: Centre pair (board, divider lowered and raised)
details.refs: s3/v3/v4 vs omaat_f32 and f5 (unchanged). The divider-up and bed-with-closed-door variants combine cleanly.

details.detail: Bed (pad, duvet, fold, drape, pillows, belt)
details.refs: q04/s5/v4 vs omaat_f57. The fold logic and the flap tone are now right. The corner is not cut back, and the drape reads as a rigid ledge.
v5: the doors, plinth, slots and void survive at grazing distance. In v4, the closed door and bed coexist without clipping.

issues.issue: The aisle drape reads as a rigid board. Its 0.014-wide top face sits just outside the duvet's rounded edge and catches light as a crisp ledge along the whole bed, like a table edge. It also overshoots the duvet's rounded head corner. In f57 the duvet edge rolls softly over the aisle side onto the tweed. This is the most visible bed artefact in q04 now that the rod is gone.
issues.evidence: qa13a/q04_drape.png: q04 x 385-740, y 440-460, a lit flat lip that projects past the duvet. s5 x 330-470, y 270-300 and v4 right unit (qa13a/v4_right.png): a thin white fence along the aisle edge.
issues.fix: Line 311: tuck the drape under the duvet edge and round it, e.g. B.add(gRBox(0.022, 0.12, dl - 0.05, 0.010, 2), M4.trs(xe + 0.006, 0.43, dz0 - dl / 2 - 0.01), duv). Its top is then 0.49, below the rounded duvet edge, so no top face shows, and the r 0.010 removes the knife edge. If a soft lip is wanted, add a quarter-round roll gRBox(0.03, 0.03, dl - 0.05, 0.014, 2) at (xe - 0.004, 0.50).

issues.issue: The turned-down corner still reads as overlays on an intact duvet. The duvet slab (line 304) keeps its square rounded outline round the corner, and the bare-sheet triangle lies on top of it at nearly the duvet's tone (0.96x). In f57 the duvet edge itself runs along the diagonal, and the sheet shows at pad level below it.
issues.evidence: qa13a/q04_duvet.png vs f57_duvet.png: corner triangle L235, duvet L244, flap L212. The duvet's rounded head and aisle edges continue unbroken around the corner.
issues.fix: Line 304: start the lofted duvet 0.30 further aft: M4.trs(dx, 0.49, dz0 - 0.30 - (dl - 0.30) / 2) with length dl - 0.30. Then fill the head band with a chamfered slab in the duvet colour, so the corner is cut away: B.add(gExtrude([[xe - dw, -dz0], [xe - 0.36, -dz0], [xe - 0.06, -dz0 + 0.30], [xe - dw, -dz0 + 0.30]], 0.035), M4.trs(0, 0.50, 0, 0, -Math.PI / 2), duv). Delete line 308, so the pad (#f0efea at about 0.50) shows in the cut corner with a 0.035 step. Raise line 309's flap to y 0.536 and line 310's roll to 0.535. Shorten line 311's drape to the same aft start.

issues.issue: Stipple moire on the fluted leaves at cabin distance, with grooves that are too light in close views. These two remain together: a darker groove alone would worsen the moire.
issues.evidence: qa13a/q02R.png (q02 x 760-900, y 180-500), chain pattern. v1: groove/slat 68/91 = 0.75 against f60's about 0.35.
issues.fix: Line 249: slats 0.0025 proud (gBox(0.0025, lh - 0.07, 0.016) at x + 0.0032), which halves the shadow steps. Line 19: fFluteGap '#393730' -> '#2a2823'. Re-check q02. If the moire persists, the far rows need a mip-mapped 0.026-period stripe (atlasUV/LAYER) in place of the slat loop, outside close-up.

issues.issue: The console module still has hard flat triangular wedge ends (a doorstop look), where f57 and f7 show radiused ends that blend into the console top.
The grip recesses are blue-black holes. In f60 they are warm, dark recesses whose lower inner lip catches light.
issues.evidence: v1 slots RGB (21,23,28) at x 158-182 and x 500-525. The f60 recess top is (14,15,10) and the lit lower lip (50,52,37), on a plinth of about (49,50,31).
issues.fix: Line 264: change the material to { c: '#16130f', r: 0.8 } (the line-241 void colour). Add a lit lip: B.add(gBox(0.006, 0.006, 0.11), M4.trs(hx + 0.004, 0.095, z), { ...plinth, c: '#4a473e' }).

issues.issue: A 1 px light vertical tick in the aft plinth face with the doors closed survives the line-262 nudge.
issues.evidence: v1 x 445, y 408-416: L83 against the plinth's L57 (qa13a/v1_seam.png). It sits at z of about -0.77/-0.78, at the closed aft leaf's end zm + 0.50, which is also the flank start.
issues.fix: Look at the geometry ending at zm + 0.50 near hx (lines 243-251 and 265-267). The leaf frame stile and the flank trim have edges there. A likely cure is to stop the line-247 groove backing and the line-253 foot trim 0.005 short of the leaf end, or to move the line-262 plinth face to hx + 0.012 so it sits proud of every leaf part (the leaves are 0.008 proud when closed).

issues.issue: The duvet head end is still a uniform rounded step.
issues.fix: Line 304: edge 0.04 -> 0.03 and crown 0.012 -> 0.02. This becomes moot for the cut head band if the corner fix above is done.

issues.issue: Out of scope, noted only: hard sun lozenges dominate the q04 bed; the ottoman tweed is warm beige where f_17313 and f11 show grey; the plaques.

questions: The doorway proportion (w12b: 0.50 leaves give a void of 0.61 of the closed pair, against 0.40 in f60) is still open. Is the 0.64 walk-in opening deliberate?
Is it acceptable to restructure the duvet (cut the head band and chamfer the corner) for the fold, at about +20 tris, rather than adding more overlays?
